versions.content: If MirrorStatusCanId is configured, the Bus Mirroring mod- ule shall create a new status item for each source bus where the reported state has changed and place it at the end of the currently active status frame buffer in the layout defined by [SWS_Mirror_00129]. The fields SINetworkType and SINetworkID shall be set according to the reported source bus, the SINetworkState field shall be set to the reported source bus state. Depending on the currently reported source bus state, the SIFrameIDAvailable shall be set to 1 or 0 . In the first case, the SIFrameID shall be set according to the reported source bus, and in the latter case the SIFrameID shall be omitted.
